flow.name: idoc-maestros-flow
flow.doc:name: IDoc maestros
flow.doc:description: Recibe IDocs de maestros vía tRFC y publica un sobre CDC por segmento en cdc.q.maestros

sap:document-listener.doc:name: Escuchar IDocs
sap:document-listener.doc:description: Servidor RFC registrado en el Gateway SAP; transacción ligada al TID del IDoc

ee:transform.doc:name: IDoc → sobres CDC
ee:transform.doc:description: Convierte cada segmento mapeado (KNA1, LFA1, MARA, MAKT...) en un sobre CDC; DOCNUM = correlationId

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 import * from dw::cdc::Envelope output application/json indent=false --- stageEvent("CAPTURED", app.name, {correlationId: vars.docnum, idocType: vars.idocType, records: sizeOf(payload), tables: payload.source.table distinctBy $})]
logger.doc:name: Log CAPTURED
logger.doc:description: Log JSON del IDoc recibido: DOCNUM, tipo y tablas afectadas

foreach.doc:name: Publicar sobres
foreach.doc:description: Publica cada sobre en la cola de maestros dentro de la transacción tRFC

until-successful.doc:name: Retry publish
until-successful.doc:description: Reintenta la publicación ante fallas transitorias de Anypoint MQ

anypoint-mq:publish.doc:name: Publicar en MQ
anypoint-mq:publish.doc:description: Publica el sobre CDC de maestros; messageId = cdcId
anypoint-mq:publish.anypoint-mq:properties: #[%dw 2.0 import * from dw::cdc::Envelope output application/java --- mqProperties(payload)]

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 import * from dw::cdc::Envelope output application/json indent=false --- stageEvent("PUBLISHED", app.name, {correlationId: vars.docnum, idocType: vars.idocType, records: sizeOf(payload)})]
logger.doc:name: Log PUBLISHED
logger.doc:description: Todos los sobres publicados: la transacción confirma y SAP marca el IDoc como entregado

foreach.collection: #[(payload groupBy $.source.table) pluck ((items, t) -> {table: t as String, records: sizeOf(items), correlationIds: items.correlationId distinctBy $})]
foreach.doc:name: Auditar por tabla
foreach.doc:description: Publica un evento PUBLISHED por tabla del IDoc con DOCNUM como correlationId

try.doc:name: Auditoría best-effort
try.doc:description: Una falla de auditoría no debe revertir ni repetir la captura

anypoint-mq:publish.doc:name: Auditoría PUBLISHED
anypoint-mq:publish.doc:description: Conteo capturado por tabla con DOCNUM para trazabilidad y conciliación
anypoint-mq:publish.anypoint-mq:body: #[%dw 2.0 import * from dw::cdc::Envelope output application/json --- stageEvent("PUBLISHED", app.name, {table: payload.table, records: payload.records, correlationIds: payload.correlationIds})]

on-error-continue.doc:name: Ignorar falla de auditoría
on-error-continue.doc:description: Registra la falla; la conciliación detectará el faltante

logger.doc:name: Log auditoría fallida
logger.doc:description: Advierte que el evento PUBLISHED no llegó a cdc.audit

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Devolver a SAP
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Rollback: SAP recibe la excepción y conserva el IDoc en SM58/BD87 para reintento

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 import * from dw::cdc::Envelope output application/json indent=false --- stageEvent("CAPTURE_FAILED", app.name, {correlationId: vars.docnum default "", idocType: vars.idocType default "", error: error.errorType.identifier, description: error.description})]
logger.doc:name: Log CAPTURE_FAILED
logger.doc:description: Registra la falla; el IDoc queda pendiente en SAP, no se pierde
